decisionBasis.skillTrigger: Requires static flow diagrams plus corresponding UI cutouts and an intent to create a clickable HTML demo.

hardGates.requirement: A numbered page flow chain with transition triggers must be presented and explicitly confirmed before continuing.
Corresponding independent UI cutouts must be supplied after Gate 1; full screenshots alone do not satisfy this requirement.
Each overlay and hotspot needs coordinates from user CSS parameters, Figma nodes, or measurement after the required one-time coordinate-source question.
The complete asset-to-page mapping, coordinates, missing-assets list and motion plan must be explicitly confirmed before HTML is written.

missingRequirements: Explicit confirmation of the numbered page flow and every transition trigger
Independent UI cutouts mapped to each visible region
A coordinate source for overlays and hotspots
Explicit confirmation of the coordinate-bearing asset mapping and missing-assets list
Explicit confirmation of the numbered camera-state flow and every transition trigger
Independent UI cutouts rather than only full-state screenshots and reference images
A coordinate source for controls, overlays and transparent hotspots
Explicit confirmation of the coordinate-bearing asset mapping and missing-assets list

conclusion: Neither frozen input can pass both mandatory confirmation gates. Generating HTML would violate the skill's explicit pre-code red line, so no execution or score is recorded.
